svg.text: y26n_humanshaped_v2 @416 — threshold vs recall & precision, fp32 vs two INT8 exports · Man
haramblur_holdout (QA set, 11,494 images) · 8,616 GT boxes · IoU ≥ 0.5 · real FP-based precision · offline replay of the floor-0.001 raw dumps (vlm-cluster/pr_curve.py, 0.01 grid)
INT8 W8A8 TFLite: max |Δrecall| 19.0 pts, max |Δprecision| 5.6 pts over thr 0.05–0.57; @0.45 Δrecall -0.7, Δprecision -0.8
INT8 + float decode ops (fix): max |Δrecall| 18.7 pts, max |Δprecision| 1.8 pts over thr 0.05–0.71; @0.45 Δrecall +0.3, Δprecision -0.8
INT8 confidences sit on a coarse ladder (int8 class-logit tensor, ≈0.3 logits/step) and stop at a ceiling; above it the export returns no boxes.
